profile.name: Thomas Scheiber
profile.headline: Software Development & Automation | Internal Applications, APIs & Cloud Deployment
profile.about:
I build software for internal operations: web applications, automation and tools that colleagues use to manage their work. At Refurbed, my work covers application development and deployment, identity integrations and endpoint automation.

I work with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python and PowerShell. Recent projects include a Git and deployment platform pilot, an optional online Git course and an advisory AI code reviewer. I deploy internal applications to Google Cloud Run through GitLab CI/CD. My background in IT administration helps me understand the support and operational problems these tools need to solve.

I also build websites and applications as a freelance web developer. I hold a B.Sc. in Engineering in Smart Homes and Assistive Technologies from FH Technikum Wien and am studying for a master's in Software Engineering at TU Wien.

employment.title: IT Administrator
cv_bullets: Developed and deployed internal applications with GitLab CI/CD and Google Cloud Run, including Entra ID sign-in, Microsoft Graph integrations and Cloud SQL databases.
Deployed a Forgejo and Coolify pilot on existing company hardware for colleagues to host and deploy applications, with access controls, AI review and recovery documentation.
Replaced USB-drive imaging with Microsoft Intune and Autopilot Device Preparation v2, adding PowerShell setup automation and PXE boot.
Managed endpoints, networking and user support in a two-person IT team.

employment.title: Freelance Web Developer
cv_bullets: Built Next.js, React and TypeScript websites for Mayr Dach and EuropeTalks, and a guest document-upload application for Villa Claudia.
Maintain production deployments on Vercel and Coolify, SEO and Core Web Vitals. Built five WordPress websites.

employment.title: Associate IAM Consultant
cv_bullets: Developed identity and access management solutions for UNIQA and AVL using One Identity Manager, PowerShell, Visual Basic and .NET.
Implemented PowerShell connectors for UNIQA as part of a Scrum team of employees and external consultants.

employment.title: IT Consultant
cv_bullets: Led Microsoft Intune and Autopilot deployment for the company's devices and deployed Jamf Pro to manage every company iPhone for ISO certification.
Managed firewalls and network infrastructure, provided first- and second-level support, and documented solutions.
